query:
WITH del AS (
                    DELETE FROM article_favorites WHERE article_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 RETURNING 1
                )
                SELECT coalesce(s.favorites_count, 0) - (SELECT count(*) FROM del) AS "favorites!"
                FROM articles a
                LEFT JOIN article_stats s ON s.article_id = a.id
                WHERE a.id = $1
